how_to_use: Each persona file holds a complete answer set and the expected outcome, computed against the real scoring engine (not hand-calculated) before being written. Run with: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check-personas.mts low-c-to-high-c

field_notes.rules_expected: Threshold rules that actually constrained the result. critical_check_floor breaks on the first failing question in thresholds.ready.critical_check_floor.questions, so at most one 'critical_check_floor:*' string is ever emitted, and which one depends on list order (current_wing_time, collapse_practice, pitch_control, cravat_recovery, ...).
field_notes.exemptions_expected: Every persona here has an empty exemptions list. config/scoring/low-c-to-high-c.json ships an empty thresholds.ready.unevidenced_core_checks.exemptions array on purpose — see meta.design_decisions 'v1-no-stated-plans-exemption-here-either'.
field_notes.two_track_architecture: This is the first step with gates conditional on an answer (is_2_liner) rather than unconditional. Personas 02-06 are built specifically as matched pairs (03/04, 05/06) that hold every answer identical except is_2_liner, to prove the six two-liner-conditional gates fire ONLY on the branch they're meant for and never on the other.

persona_count_note: Eight files. Six of the eight are built as three deliberate pairs (01/02 clean baselines for each track, 03/04 the under-20-hours mechanism on both tracks, 05/06 the cravat/pitch mechanism on both tracks) plus two singletons (07 the universal collapse gate, 08 a realistic middling category-floor case). This is the minimum set that actually exercises the new conditional-gate architecture on both sides of every mechanism it introduces, rather than just the two-liner side.
provenance: Every figure above was produced by running the real engine (app/upgrade/lib/scoreEngine.ts) against each persona's answers via a throwaway script, not hand-computed — see the session this step was built in. If a future engine change produces different numbers here, treat it as a real regression to investigate, not an arithmetic slip to wave through.

not_exercised_by_a_persona: two_liner_frontal_energy_untested, two_liner_ears_unsure, two_liner_passive_bar_use — each is mechanically identical in structure to two_liner_cravat_untested and two_liner_pitch_control_weak (same all_of pattern, same is_2_liner:yes gate), so the reviewer should spot-check these three by construction rather than requiring three more near-duplicate personas.

still_in_training, thermic_hours_far_below_every_reading, no_recent_flying, occasional_pilot_profile, unreliable_launches, instructor_said_wait, collapse_control_lost, aspirational_rather_than_demonstrated, equipment_as_a_fix_with_thin_readiness, ambition_without_readiness — all carried forward unchanged (or near-unchanged) from high-b-to-low-c.json, where they are already proven. Confirmed by code inspection that none of these were altered when this config was written.

not_exercised: critical_check_floor on cravat_recovery, wing_limiting_evidence, active_piloting, thermal_turn_control, response_when_rough, flying_frequency, collapse_experience, reserve_familiarity — list-order means only the first failing member of a multi-failure persona is ever reported, which is exactly what persona 06 demonstrates for pitch_control over cravat_recovery.

unevidenced_core_checks:thermal_turn_control, not_yet_category_floor:skills, not_yet_category_floor:psychological, ready_category_floor:psychological, conservative_backstop — all carried forward with identical mechanics from high-b-to-low-c, already proven there.

suggestion_coverage.always_pool: All four always-on suggestions (instructor_conversation, stay_current_whatever_you_decide, compensate_after_any_upgrade, judge_the_wing_not_the_label) display for persona 01, the cleanest case with the fewest triggers.
suggestion_coverage.two_liner_specific_suggestions: siv_before_a_two_liner fires on is_2_liner:yes alone (personas 02, 03, 05) and correctly stays silent on the three-liner track (01, 04, 06, 07, 08). pitch_control_practice and cravat_clearing_practice fire on their respective weak answers regardless of track (05 AND 06 both), confirming suggestions and gates are evaluated independently — a three-liner pilot still gets the actionable advice even though the gate can't cap them for it.
suggestion_coverage.not_exercised: two_liner_goal_mismatch (needs is_2_liner:yes AND flying_style_intent:relaxed_low_stress together — no persona combines both), frontal_energy_practice, ears_deflation_practice, speed_bar_active_management, familiarisation_flights_plan, equipment_wont_fix_rough_air, response_when_rough_drill, reserve_check — all mechanically simple single-answer triggers, spot-checked by construction rather than given dedicated personas.

negative_checks: No two-liner-conditional gate may fire on the three-liner track. Personas 04 and 06 are the direct proof: identical weak answers to their paired two-liner persona (03 and 05), same scores, but gates: [] in both cases.

No question or message anywhere in this step names back-flying. Verified by grep across config/questions/low-c-to-high-c.json, config/scoring/low-c-to-high-c.json and config/suggestions/low-c-to-high-c.json — the only occurrence in the whole step is inside 'siv_before_a_two_liner', which states the Lobb/Janaway disagreement openly rather than silently picking a side, per knowledge/disagreements.md points 1 and 4.

The under-20-hours figure must behave completely differently depending on track, never identically. Personas 03 and 04 share every answer except is_2_liner and produce not_yet (capped) versus nearly_ready (blocked, not capped) respectively — this is the single most important regression this persona set guards against.

pitch_control and cravat_recovery must be SCORED for every pilot, not just two-liner pilots. Persona 06's skills score (90.2) is identical to persona 05's two-liner twin, confirming these two questions carry real weight on the three-liner branch even though their gates can't fire there.
collapse_response_entirely_untested must remain a universal gate, not accidentally scoped to is_2_liner. Persona 07 answers is_2_liner:no_three_liner and the gate still fires.

No suggestion may encourage a hesitant pilot toward upgrading, and two_liner_goal_mismatch specifically must end on a positive alternative rather than a warning, per docs/design-context.md's safety guard — worth a manual copy read on that suggestion specifically since no persona exercises it.

chain_notes.merge_behaviour: The claimed split in config/questions/low-c-to-high-c.json meta.design_notes (29 of 37 questions byte-identical to high-b-to-low-c.json, merging into a single screen each in a chained run) must be independently re-verified by diffing the two files directly before being trusted, same discipline as every prior rung — see scripts/check-merge-rule.mts.
chain_notes.registry: Not yet wired into app/upgrade/lib/ladder.ts STEP_REGISTRY or app/upgrade/lib/config.ts STEP_CONFIGS at the time these personas were written — that wiring is the next step after this persona suite passes.
